status: bounded ownership defects repaired; full serial acceptance remains open

constraints.observer: RSS, QApplication widget snapshots, weak references, creation origins and read-only referrers

defects: Four test-created folded settings pages lacked qtbot ownership; each now registers its page.
Model-only tests built parentless controls without retiring them; their explicit model fixture now closes and schedules deletion of only already-built controls.
Eager and lazy SettingsWidgets construction did not consistently use the supplied Qt owner; controls are now adopted without disturbing existing parent relationships.
Waiting categories detached controls with setParent(None); a hidden screen-owned parking widget now retains Qt ownership until a layout adopts them.
HomePage retained a hidden, parentless StageLegend; it now owns the hidden legend and deletes it with the page.

before_checks.meaning: Eager and lazy controls remained valid after their declared Qt owner was deleted while Python model and wrapper references were deliberately retained.

combined_batch.failure: The old legend test required parent=None. Its contract now checks hidden page ownership, exclusion from the displayed aside, and destruction with the page.

limitations: This bounded result does not prove completion or the memory ceiling of the 27,186-test serial acceptance run.

One final combined batch reported a busy JobRunner at the opening-module test boundary; no test failed for that warning and the final Qt widget count was zero. Its longer-session behavior remains to be checked.
An intermediate legend rerun exposed an authoring typo calling the legend property; it was corrected before the passing focused rerun.
Earlier exploratory db-browser/dialog-sequence/early-prefix probes accidentally enabled pytest-randomly and are not ordered reproductions. The ordered prefix explicitly disables it.
